## Summary

The bug was in `app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts`'s `search()` method: `q.orWhere('published', true)` was placed *inside* the same OR-group as the keyword matches, so the whole `where` clause resolved to "any post whose title/excerpt matches a keyword, **or** any published post" — meaning unpublished posts leaked through when they matched a keyword, and published posts were padded into the results even without a keyword match. Fixed by moving `published = true` to its own top-level `.where()` (AND'd with the keyword group), matching the pattern already used in `index()` and `show()`. Added a fixtures-based regression test suite in `tests/PostController.test.ts` (using real `Post`/`User` model rows against the migrated test SQLite DB) covering: single-keyword search excluding an unpublished post, multi-keyword search excluding an unpublished match, and a keyword unique to an unpublished post returning an empty result — verified the new tests fail against the old code and pass against the fix.
